accessibility.en_plain: Make the behavior easier to carry out by removing practical barriers such as distance, scheduling, delivery friction, or service availability.
accessibility.en_caution: This is about practical access, not price. A service can be affordable but still difficult to reach.
accessibility.zh_plain: 通过减少距离、预约、配送、服务可获得性等现实阻碍，让目标行为更容易真正做出来。
accessibility.zh_caution: 它讲的是“做不做得到、方不方便”，不是“贵不贵”。一个服务可以很便宜，但仍然很难获得。

affordability.en_plain: Reduce the money someone must spend to perform a behavior or obtain a service.
affordability.en_caution: Affordability reduces the cost of acting; it is different from paying someone a reward for acting.
affordability.zh_plain: 降低执行某个行为或获得某项服务需要付出的直接金钱成本。
affordability.zh_caution: 它是“让行动更便宜”，不是“做了以后给你钱”；后者属于 financial incentives。

anticipated-regret.en_plain: Before deciding, imagine how much you might regret doing—or not doing—the behavior later.
anticipated-regret.en_caution: The current MetaRank evidence is correlational, so it shows association rather than proven causal leverage.
anticipated-regret.zh_plain: 在做决定之前，先想到未来如果做了或没做这件事，自己可能会有多后悔。
anticipated-regret.zh_caution: MetaRank 目前收录的是相关性证据，因此它说明“有关联”，还不能直接说预期后悔本身造成了行为改变。

autonomous-motivation.en_plain: Act because the goal feels personally chosen, meaningful, or aligned with your values—not mainly because of pressure.
autonomous-motivation.en_caution: This is motivation quality, not simply how strongly you intend to act.
autonomous-motivation.zh_plain: 因为这件事是自己认同、主动选择、觉得有意义，所以愿意行动，而不是主要因为外界或内在压力逼着自己做。
autonomous-motivation.zh_caution: 它强调的是“为什么想做”的动机质量，不等同于单纯的 intention 强弱。

behavioral-attitudes.en_plain: How positively or negatively a person evaluates doing the specific behavior—whether it seems good, useful, worthwhile, pleasant, or harmful.
behavioral-attitudes.en_caution: This is attitude toward the behavior itself, not a broad attitude toward a person, institution, or topic.
behavioral-attitudes.zh_plain: 一个人觉得“做这个具体行为”到底是好还是坏、值得还是不值得、有益还是有害。
behavioral-attitudes.zh_caution: 这里指的是对具体行为本身的评价，不是对某个人、机构或话题的一般态度。

default-options.en_plain: Preselect one option so it happens automatically unless the person actively changes it.
default-options.en_caution: Defaults are a choice-architecture intervention. Their effect can depend heavily on context and on what the default signals.
default-options.zh_plain: 预先替人选好一个选项；如果对方不主动修改，就自动采用这个选择。
default-options.zh_caution: 默认选项属于 choice architecture。效果会受到场景、默认选项代表的含义以及退出成本影响。

education-information.en_plain: Give people facts, explanations, or educational material that may help them make or carry out a behavioral choice.
education-information.en_caution: An education intervention is not the same as proving that measured knowledge is the causal mediator.
education-information.zh_plain: 给人提供事实、解释或教育材料，让其更了解目标行为以及相关选择。
education-information.zh_caution: “提供信息的干预有效”不等于已经证明“知识增加”就是导致行为改变的那个中介机制。

fear-appeals.en_plain: Use messages that deliberately emphasize threat or frightening consequences in order to motivate action.
fear-appeals.en_caution: The current effect in MetaRank combines attitudes, intentions, and behavior, so it is excluded from the direct-behavior leaderboard.
fear-appeals.zh_plain: 通过强调威胁、危险或令人害怕的后果，试图推动人采取行动。
fear-appeals.zh_caution: MetaRank 当前这条效应把态度、意图和行为混合在一起，所以没有进入 direct-behavior 排名。

financial-incentives.en_plain: Offer money or another material financial reward contingent on performing the target behavior or reaching an outcome.
financial-incentives.en_caution: Effects may weaken after incentives stop, and OR/RR estimates should not be compared numerically with d or r.
financial-incentives.zh_plain: 把金钱或具有货币价值的奖励与目标行为或目标结果绑定：做到了，就获得奖励。
financial-incentives.zh_caution: 激励停止以后效果可能减弱；而且 OR/RR 不能直接和 d 或 r 比数字大小。

goal-setting.en_plain: Specify a concrete target or standard to work toward, such as a behavioral amount, frequency, or outcome.
goal-setting.en_caution: A goal says what you want to achieve; it does not by itself specify the cue-response plan used in implementation intentions.
goal-setting.zh_plain: 明确一个要达到的具体标准，例如行为次数、数量、时间或结果目标。
goal-setting.zh_caution: Goal setting 主要回答“我要达到什么”；它不等于 implementation intention 那种“如果 X 出现，我就做 Y”的执行规则。

habit.en_plain: A behavior becomes increasingly automatic because the same response has been repeated in recurring contexts or cues.
habit.en_caution: The current rank is association-only; habit may both influence behavior and partly reflect repeated past behavior.
habit.zh_plain: 同一个行为在相似情境或线索下反复发生后，逐渐变成不用太多思考就会自动触发的反应。
habit.zh_caution: 目前进入的是相关性榜单。习惯可能推动未来行为，但习惯强度本身也可能反映过去已经重复过很多次的行为。

identity.en_plain: Represent a behavior, role, or goal as part of who you are—for example, “I am someone who exercises” rather than only “I want to exercise.”
identity.en_caution: MetaRank currently has identity-to-intention, identity-to-habit, and intervention-to-identity evidence, but no eligible direct identity-to-behavior effect in the leaderboard yet.
identity.zh_name: 身份认同 / 自我身份
identity.zh_plain: 把某种行为、角色或目标纳入“我是谁”的自我概念，例如不是只说“我想运动”，而是“我是一个会运动的人”。
identity.zh_caution: 目前仓库里有 identity→intention、identity→habit，以及 intervention→identity 的证据，但还没有一条合格的 identity→behavior 直接效应进入榜单。

implementation-intentions.en_plain: Create an if–then rule that links a specific cue to a specific response: “If X happens, then I will do Y.”
implementation-intentions.en_caution: This is more specific than ordinary intention; it programs when or under what cue the behavior should occur.
implementation-intentions.zh_name: 执行意图 / If–Then 计划
implementation-intentions.zh_plain: 把一个具体线索和一个具体行动绑定成规则：“如果 X 出现，那么我就做 Y。”
implementation-intentions.zh_caution: 它比普通 intention 更具体：不仅想做，而且提前规定在什么线索出现时执行什么动作。

intentions.en_plain: A conscious commitment or stated readiness to perform a behavior.
intentions.en_caution: Wanting or intending to act is not identical to acting; MetaRank keeps intention effects separate from implementation-intention effects.
intentions.zh_plain: 一个人有意识地表达“我准备做、我打算做某个行为”的承诺或准备程度。
intentions.zh_caution: 想做不等于真的做。MetaRank 会把普通 intention 与 implementation intention 分开。

perceived-competence.en_plain: The feeling that you are effective and capable at carrying out the target behavior.
perceived-competence.en_caution: It overlaps with self-efficacy but comes from a different theoretical tradition; MetaRank does not pool them automatically.
perceived-competence.zh_plain: 一个人觉得自己在执行某个目标行为时是有能力、有效率、做得到的。
perceived-competence.zh_caution: 它与 self-efficacy 很接近，但理论来源和测量传统并不完全相同，因此 MetaRank 暂时不把两者直接合并。

prompts-reminders.en_plain: Place an external cue at the right moment so the intended behavior comes back into attention.
prompts-reminders.en_caution: A reminder changes salience at the moment of action; it is different from teaching new information or creating an internal if–then plan.
prompts-reminders.zh_plain: 在行动机会出现时给一个外部线索，让目标行为重新进入注意力，例如通知、提示牌、短信提醒。
prompts-reminders.zh_caution: 提醒主要改变当下的注意力和显著性；它不同于教育信息，也不同于自己预先写好的 if–then 计划。

punishment.en_plain: Attach a negative consequence to noncooperation or an undesired behavior.
punishment.en_caution: The current high-ranked estimate comes from experimental social dilemmas; it should not be generalized directly to legal punishment or everyday self-punishment.
punishment.zh_plain: 把负面后果与不合作或不希望出现的行为绑定，使该行为需要付出代价。
punishment.zh_caution: 当前排名较高的证据主要来自实验室 social dilemma；不能直接外推到法律处罚，更不能理解成“对自己越狠越有效”。

risk-appraisal.en_plain: Assess how likely and how serious a threat or harmful outcome seems before deciding what to do.
risk-appraisal.en_caution: Risk appraisal is the psychological appraisal itself; fear appeals are messages designed to change such appraisals or emotions.
risk-appraisal.zh_plain: 在行动前判断某种风险有多可能发生、后果有多严重，以及这个风险对自己意味着什么。
risk-appraisal.zh_caution: Risk appraisal 是人的心理判断；fear appeal 是一种试图改变这种判断或情绪的沟通干预，两者不是同一个东西。

self-efficacy.en_plain: Believe that you can successfully execute the specific actions required by the target behavior.
self-efficacy.en_caution: Self-efficacy is task-specific capability belief, not generic self-esteem or positive thinking.
self-efficacy.zh_plain: 相信自己有能力把目标行为需要的具体动作真正执行出来。
self-efficacy.zh_caution: Self-efficacy 是针对具体任务的能力信念，不等于一般性的自信、自尊或“积极想一想”。

self-monitoring.en_plain: Track or record your own behavior so that what you are actually doing becomes visible and can be regulated.
self-monitoring.en_caution: Many self-monitoring interventions are multicomponent, so the causal effect of self-monitoring alone can be less certain than the trial-level intervention effect.
self-monitoring.zh_plain: 记录、观察自己的真实行为，让“我到底做了多少、什么时候做”变得可见，从而便于调整。
self-monitoring.zh_caution: 很多 self-monitoring 研究同时包含其他干预成分，所以随机试验能证明整个方案有效，不一定能完全拆出“记录本身”的独立因果效应。

social-norms.en_plain: Perceptions about what other people do or what other people approve of.
social-norms.en_caution: Descriptive norms (what others do) and injunctive norms (what others approve) may differ and may later be split into separate MetaRank mechanisms.
social-norms.zh_plain: 一个人对“别人通常怎么做”或者“别人认为应该怎么做”的感知。
social-norms.zh_caution: 描述性规范（别人实际怎么做）和命令性规范（别人赞成什么）可能并不相同，未来可能会在 MetaRank 里拆成两个机制。

social-support.en_plain: Receive practical, informational, emotional, or tangible help from other people that makes the target behavior easier to carry out.
social-support.en_caution: The current causal estimate is domain-specific to HIV treatment adherence, so it is not a universal social-support effect.
social-support.zh_plain: 从他人那里得到实际帮助、信息、情绪支持或物质资源，让目标行为更容易完成。
social-support.zh_caution: 当前因果估计来自 HIV 治疗依从性，不能直接当成“社会支持对所有行为都有同样大小的效果”。

trust-healthcare-professional.en_plain: Trust that a clinician or healthcare professional is competent, honest, and acting in the patient's interest.
trust-healthcare-professional.en_caution: Current evidence is correlational and specific to clinical relationships; it is not the same as generalized or institutional trust.
trust-healthcare-professional.zh_name: 对医疗专业人员的信任
trust-healthcare-professional.zh_plain: 相信医生或其他医疗专业人员有能力、诚实，并且会以患者利益为出发点。
trust-healthcare-professional.zh_caution: 当前是相关性证据，而且针对临床关系；它不等于一般社会信任或对机构制度的信任。
